Hina.lead: Sorasaki Hina is a student of Gehenna Academy and the head prefect of its Prefect Team. She is introduced in the main story's first volume, where she warns Sensei about the Kaiser Corporation's activities in Abydos. In the main story's third volume she pushes Gehenna to accept the Eden Treaty, which she sees as her chance to retire.
Hina.intro: Head prefect of the Gehenna Prefect Team. Somewhat aloof and considers almost everything a bother and chore, but is still every bit the head prefect of the Prefect Team when it comes to rules and regulations. Her general response to most things is "Ugh, so annoying," but she's ruthless and decisive when it comes to matters on the battlefield. Feared and respected by the enemies of Gehenna.
relationships: Ako. Hina's senior administrator and most devoted subordinate.

Hoshino. Hina and Hoshino first meet in the first volume, when Hina recognizes Hoshino from her time on Gehenna's Intelligence Committee. After the Eden Treaty attack, Hina tells Sensei she cannot be as strong as Hoshino, who stayed at Abydos and kept fighting.

Sensei. In her relationship story, Hina meets Sensei in secret, since her fame makes any public meeting a problem. When Arius attacks the Eden Treaty signing ceremony, she shields Sensei and is wounded. Afterwards she breaks down and tries to retire on the spot. Sensei stays with her until she recovers, and she admits she was just "trying to be spoiled for once."

Arisu.lead: Tendou Aris is a student of Millennium Science School and a member of the Game Development Department, found dormant in the ruins beneath a factory and brought in as the club's fourth member. She is introduced in the main story's second volume, which later reveals her to be AL-1S, an android built by the nameless priests as a weapon meant to destroy the world.
Arisu.intro: Student of Millennium and member of the Game development club. She was found sleeping inside some ruins. Everything about her is unknown, including her age. Currently, she enjoys playing videogames with Momoi, Midori and Yuzu and has become a serious game maniac. Because she picks up lines from retro games, her speech tends to be hesitant and unnatural.
relationships: Momoi, Midori, and Yuzu. The three of them found Aris dormant in the ruins, named her, and brought her into the Game Development Department as its fourth member. When the AI inside her took over, they entered her mental space and told her she could choose her own class, and she chose to be a hero.

Kei. Kei, the AI the main story calls Key, was the other mind inside Aris's body. When she took over Aris's body during volume 2 chapter 2, Aris rejected Kei and declared herself a hero rather than the princess of the Nameless Gods. In volume F, Kei is temporarily awakened to help Aris. In volume EX, Kei is given a body by Aris's request.
Rio. The president of Seminar, she identified Aris as a weapon meant to destroy the world and attempted to destroy her halo. She later helps bring Kei back at Aris's request.

Sensei. Sensei was with the Game Development Department when Aris was found in the ruins. Aris treats Sensei as a party member and asks Sensei to keep going on adventures with her. She credits Sensei's words with teaching her that she can choose what to be.
trivia: Aris is the official spelling, derived from her codename "AL-1S", but this is at odds with the Japanese romanization, so the fandom usually prefers either: Arisu —valid; Arisu Tachibana and Arisu Sakayanagi are notable use cases. Alice —focusing on common usage by which アリス is a transcription of Alice (e.g. 不思議の国の アリス ); more common translation from a given name アリス in any case (e.g. Alice Kurobane, Alice Kuonji, Alice Nakiri, etc.).

Fubuki.intro: A lazy student of the Community Safety Bureau of Valkyrie Police Academy. She enrolled in the Valkyrie Police Academy pursuing the carefree life of a civil servant. Treats any incoming complaints with utter indifference, and enjoys the life of a window-gazer who's not motivated by money nor honor. Her favorite thing to do is to listen to the radio while eating a doughnut.

exSkill.name: First of all, rest well
exSkill.desc: Increase Attack by 36.5~69.4% for 46 seconds.

weapon.name: No. 14 Valkyrie Standard Rifle
weapon.desc: Standard model rifle provided to Fubuki by Valkyrie Police Academy. Designed for high power, but performs below expectation due to Fubuki's lackluster maintenance.

Fuuka.name: Fuuka
Fuuka.lead: Belonging to Gehenna Academy's School Lunch Club, Fuuka is in charge of managing the school's cafeteria.
Fuuka.intro: Belonging to Gehenna Academy's School Lunch Club, Fuuka is in charge of managing the school's cafeteria. Working hard every morning to make a huge number of meals for everyone in the school, her kindness and diligence make her a rarity amongst Gehenna students. While her meals are certainly good, due to the school cafeteria being understaffed, her true culinary skills tend to go undervalued. Nevertheless, she puts in effort day by day to provide tastier meals to everyone.
trivia: Her distinctive expression is beloved by the developers and her designer.

exSkill.name: Lunch Time!
exSkill.desc: Fuuka moves allies (max 4) in circular area to a specified position and recovers their HP by 109~207% of her Healing.

weapon.name: School Lunch Club self-defense gun type A
weapon.desc: A submachine gun that Fuuka always carries. Intended for the purpose of controlling the troublemakers in cafeteria, but things usually quiet down before Fuuka gets to use it.

Fuyu seems confident and composed, but facing unexpected situations can leave her shaken and unsure of herself.

Hanae.name: Hanae

Hanae.intro: Newly enrolled at Trinity Integrated Academy, Hanae is a lively and cheerful girl who belongs to the Remedial Knights. She has a positive attitude towards everything and is full of energy, but has a tendency to become overexcited when she finds a patient, usually making the situation worse. Despite being quite an eccentric character, strangely enough, patients who have received her care have all recovered right away no matter their illness.

exSkill.name: It's treatment time～!
exSkill.desc: Continuously recover one ally HP by 54.1~102% of Healing. (Duration: 20 seconds )

weapon.name: Happy Smiley
weapon.desc: An assault rifle that Hanae brings when examining a patient. Supposedly, any patient would smile in the presence of this gun (?).

Hanako.intro: Trinity's Supplemental Lessons Club's paragon of sensitivity. At first glance, Hanako appears graceful and ladylike... Or so one may think. exSkill.nameJP: 禁じられた遊びを始めましょう
exSkill.name: Let's begin the forbidden games
exSkill.desc: Apply continuous healing equivalent to 26.9~51.1% of Hanako's Healing to allies in a certain area. (Duration: 8 seconds )

weapon.name: Honest Wish
weapon.desc: Hanako's assault rifle. Even if you ask her where the name came from, she won't tell you.

Hare.title: Hare
Hare.name: Hare
Hare.lead: A member of hacker group Veritas of Millennium.
Hare.intro: A member of hacker group Veritas of Millennium. Among the many geniuses of Millenium, she is one of the most prominent. Most of the advanced cutting-edge devices in Millennium were created by her. However, despite her ability and achievements, she isn't one to brag. She is kind, friendly with other students and a good listener.

exSkill.name: Deploy EMP Drone
exSkill.desc: Deal 271~435% damage to enemies in a circular area and Stun them for 2.7~3.5 seconds.

weapon.name: Auto-aimer
weapon.desc: Hare's Assault rifle. It comes with various cutting-edge features such as the automatic aiming function, but Hare hardly seems to use it.

Haruka.title: Haruka
Haruka.name: Haruka
Haruka.lead: Rank-and-file member of Gehenna Academy's Problem Solver 68.
Haruka.intro: Rank-and-file member of Gehenna Academy's Problem Solver 68. Due to her gloomy personality, she has always been teased, but was able to escape that fate thanks to Aru. Afterwards she has operated in Problem Solver 68 as a role akin to the youngest child in a family. Despite her shyness and little self-esteem, it wouldn't be incorrect in saying she's the scariest among the erratic Problem Solver 68.

exSkill.name: Erratic Shooting
exSkill.desc: Deal 821~1560% damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

weapon.name: Blow Away
weapon.desc: A shotgun used by Haruka to exterminate pests. The definition of "pest" seems to be on a case-by-case basis.

Haruna.title: Haruna
Haruna.name: Haruna
Haruna.lead: Enrolled at Gehenna Academy, Haruna is the club president of the Gourmet Research Society.
Haruna.intro: Enrolled at Gehenna Academy, Haruna is the club president of the Gourmet Research Society. Upon first look at her, one might think she is a rich princess-like and aloof elegance, but get her involved in talks of food and all sense of distinction is lost in this zealous gourmet. In contrast to such gluttony, she is actually not one with much of an appetite. Favorite foods are greasy, full of hormones, and stew-centric.

exSkill.name: Piercing Elegance
exSkill.desc: Deal 506~887% damage to enemies in a straight line. Damage decreases by 10% each time shot pierces an enemy. (Damage reduction caps at a minimum of 30% damage)

weapon.name: Ideal
weapon.desc: The sniper rifle used by Haruna. By staring down its scope you can see the path leading to the ultimate gourmet, according to Haruna.

Hasumi.title: Hasumi
Hasumi.name: Hasumi
Hasumi.lead: Hanekawa Hasumi is a student of Trinity General School and the vice president of the Justice Task Force. Standing in for Tsurugi due to her volatile nature in matters relating to the Force, she is first introduced in the the main story's prologue and one of the four students the player obtains upon beginning the game.
Hasumi.intro: Enrolled at Trinity Integrated Academy, Hasumi is the Justice Actualization Committee 's No. 2. In place of its president, Tsurugi, who embodies wildness, Hasumi also acts as the Justice Actualization Committee's tactical commander. At a glance she appears composed and intellectual, like the archetypal Trinity student. However, Hasumi too is a fully-fledged member of the Justice Actualization Committee, and will sometimes act recklessly while retaining her composed nature.

exSkill.nameJP: アーマーピアッシング弾
exSkill.name: Armour-piercing ammo
exSkill.desc: Deal 574~1091% damage to one enemy.

weapon.name: Impalement
weapon.desc: Hasumi's favorite sniper rifle. Both the dignified old-fashioned style and the immense power in spite of that seem to reflect those of the rifle's owner.

Hatsune Miku.title: Hatsune Miku
Hatsune Miku.name: Hatsune Miku
Hatsune Miku.lead: The always-cheerful virtual singer who really loves to sing.
Hatsune Miku.intro: The always-cheerful virtual singer who really loves to sing. Originally a purely electronic existence, the technology of Kivotos has allowed Miku to obtain a real body and stand in the real world. As expected of a singer whose music can overcome time and space, Miku has many secret fans in Kivotos who are eagerly looking forward to the live concert that she's planning to hold in this world.

exSkill.nameJP: この一瞬一瞬に、心を込めて！
exSkill.name: Putting my heart into it at every moment!
exSkill.desc: Heal allies within a circular area for 111~144% of Miku's Healing.

weapon.name: Live Concert T-shirt Cannon
weapon.desc: A huge cannon used by Hatsune Miku to distribute merchandise such as T-shirts during her live performances. The surface lights up in sync with the music.

Hibiki.name: Hibiki
Hibiki.lead: Hibiki belongs to the Engineering Club of Millennium Science School.
Hibiki.intro: Hibiki belongs to the Engineering Club of Millennium Science School. Despite being unsociable and unsophisticated in speech, she exhibits a prominent natural ability in engineering and has invented many marvellous objects. Her inventions are practically without flaws and while it wouldn't be too much to call them masterpieces, they always include at least one bizarre feature that leaves their users bewildered.

exSkill.nameJP: これは高確率で痛いよ
exSkill.name: There's a high probability this will hurt
exSkill.desc: Deal 311~591% damage to enemies in 5 circular areas.

weapon.desc: Hibiki's fondly used mortar. Occasionally finding use in her daily experiments, it is used to fire various other things alongside shells.

Hifumi.name: Hifumi
Hifumi.hobbies: Collecting Peroro goods, collecting cute things, shopping, giving advice
Hifumi.lead: A sensitive girl, Hifumi is a student of Trinity Integrated Academy and a member of the Supplementary Classes Club.
Hifumi.intro: A sensitive girl, Hifumi is a student of Trinity Integrated Academy and a member of the Supplementary Classes Club. Despite her average grades and appearance, Hifumi's gentle and kind personality has gained her popularity. While she will gladly lend an ear to those with problems, she has a tendency to be swept up in the moment and unintentionally cause trouble.

exSkill.name: Help me, Peroro-sama!
exSkill.desc: Summon a Peroro Doll, dealing 202~386% damage to enemies in a circular area and taunting them. The Peroro Doll additionally inherits 160% of Hifumi's Max HP.

weapon.name: My Necessity
weapon.desc: The pink assault rifle carried around by Hifumi. Much like her other favorite goods, it's a must-bring item whenever Hifumi goes out.

Hikari.title: Hikari
Hikari.name: Hikari
Hikari.lead: A student at the Highlander Railway Academy and an officer of the CCC (Central Control Center).
Hikari.intro: A student at the Highlander Railway Academy and an officer of the CCC (Central Control Center). She has outstanding talent for driving trains, and was chosen as an officer along with her younger twin sister Nozomi. However, Hikari is terrible at paperwork and administrative tasks. She follows her whims and does things at her own pace without worrying about what others think, which causes all kinds of incidents.

exSkill.name: Ti~cket~ check
exSkill.desc: Increase Sonic Efficiency of one other ally by 48.8~92.7% for 32 seconds. If the target can consume additional EX skill Cost, reduce the additional consumption cost of EX skill by 1~2 for 1 use of EX skill.

weapon.name: Ticket Punch
weapon.desc: Hikari's favorite handgun. It's extremely effective against unruly and "annoying" passengers. She seems to be keeping it well-maintained.

Himari.title: Himari
Himari.name: Himari
Himari.lead: Enrolled at Millennium Science School, the former director of the hacker group "Veritas" and the current director of the Supernatural Phenomenon Task Force.
Himari.intro: Enrolled at Millennium Science School, the former director of the hacker group "Veritas" and the current director of the Supernatural Phenomenon Task Force. A self-proclaimed super genius and sickly beautiful girl hacker, who is said to be an owner of the "Omniscience" degree, something only three people in the history of Millennium could claim....it's not entirely clear if that is true or whether such degree even exists. According to Himari, a girl with many secrets is alluring... She is also a leading genius hacker, and at the same time, has a penchant for all things occult.

exSkill.nameJP: 実力をお見せしましょう
exSkill.name: Let me show you what I can do
exSkill.desc: Increase Attack of one ally by 55.2~105% for 13 seconds.

weapon.name: Clifftop Flower
weapon.desc: A pistol owned by Himari. It is a simple and beautifully crafted gun. It's quite unusual to see Himari use it. "Naturally, one doesn't get to see the most delicate mountain flowers easily ...just like me, aren't they?", Himari says.

Hinata.intro: Hinata is a serious and earnest Sisterhood member from the Trinity Integrated Academy. She is responsible for the "management of the cathedral and other items", a job she performs faithfully every day. However, she is a bit of a dilettante, and often loses confidence after making a series of mistakes. She carries with surprising ease a large suitcase with various items in it, including a grenade launcher.

exSkill.name: Last resort
exSkill.desc: Deal 250~476% damage to enemies within 5 circular areas.

weapon.name: Blessing
weapon.desc: A pistol that Hinata always carries. In peacetime, it is used to help people in need, such as opening a door when they've lost the key.

Hiyori.name: Hiyori

She is occasionally seen carrying a heavy luggage on her back and following slightly behind everyone else.

exSkill.desc: Fires a bullet that flies in a straight line and deals 207~331% damage to the first enemy it hits. weapon.name: Identity
weapon.desc: Sniper rifle used by Hiyori. The 20mm bullets strike true, asserting their presence on the gunfire-filled battlefield.

Hoshino.title: Hoshino
Hoshino.name: Hoshino
Hoshino.lead: Takanashi Hoshino is a third-year student of Abydos High School and president of the Foreclosure Task Force, the club that all five of the school's remaining students belong to. She is introduced in the main story's first volume, where the club takes on Sensei as its advisor while trying to pay off the school's debt. Partway through the volume she signs an agreement with Black Suit to drop out of Abydos in exchange for most of that debt being cleared, and the rest of the club rescues her.
Hoshino.intro: A young, lazy girl from Abydos High School. She's currently the vice president of the Abydos Student Council, and is also the president of the Countermeasure Council. Speaking like an old man, she enjoys playing around more than work. Because of this, she's often the subject of anger from the rest of the council, but once the mission starts she protects the other members by fighting valiantly on the front lines.
relationships: Yume. The previous president of the Abydos Student Council, whom Hoshino served under as vice president.

Shiroko. Hoshino found her in the Abydos ruins with no memory of who she was and gave her her own scarf, then beat her in a fight on the condition that she stay in Abydos. Shiroko still has the scarf, and tells Hoshino she would have died alone in the desert without her.

Nonomi. Hoshino turned down her offer to clear the school's debt with the Nephthys Group's money and told her she could help pay it off as an Abydos student instead, which Nonomi enrolled in order to do.

Sensei. In the letter she leaves when she drops out of Abydos, Hoshino writes that she had never thought adults could be trusted before meeting Sensei. In her relationship story, she lends Sensei the pillow she calls her one-of-a-kind treasure so that Sensei will take a nap.

exSkill.name: Tactical Suppression
exSkill.desc: Deal 435~697% of Hoshino's Attack as damage to enemies within a conical area and stun them for 0~1.4 seconds.

weapon.name: Eye of Horus
weapon.desc: Hoshino's beloved shotgun, sporting a simple design. While she may be lazy at heart, Hoshino does not slack off when it comes to maintaining her weapon.

Ibuki.name: Ibuki
Ibuki.lead: A student from Gehenna Academy, member of the Pandemonium Society, and a mascot-like girl. She was originally a student of Gehenna Academy's elementary school, but Ibuki's ability was recognized and she joined Gehenna's "Pandemonium Society", which only the best students can enter. Being the youngest member of the Pandemonium Society, she is loved by everyone for her earnest cuteness. She is a well-behaved girl who works diligently so as not to cause trouble for her seniors.

weapon.name: Bang bang!-chan

As the leader of its assault corps, she punishes students that she finds breaking the rules with overwhelming force. While she may be quick-thinking, good at her job and possessing a decent sense of combat, Iori is also prone to losing sight of her surroundings once she spots an enemy. This recklessness can lead to her falling into even the simplest of traps.

exSkill.name: Total Arrest
exSkill.desc: Fires 3 shots at an enemy. Each shot has 350~666% Attack power and deals damage in a conical shape behind the enemy.

Iroha.title: Iroha
Iroha.name: Iroha
Iroha.lead: One of the members of "Pandemonium Society" within Gehenna Academy. She's easily irritable and tries to slack from her duties. Those attempts are repeatedly blocked by fellow Pandemonium members (specifically, Makoto). Pandemonium officer's days are always busy with problems to solve and tasks that have to be done, even if one finds them annoying. Ibuki, Pandemonium Society's mascot, always helps to keep Iroha's spirit up, and so, with a sigh, she continues to carry out her daily duties.

Izumi.name: Izumi

Introduced as part of Arisu 's programming in the main story's second volume and as part of the Nameless Priests' weapon to destroy Kivotos, gradually she would spit from her original body overtime; upon the conclusion of Volume F, she would be retained as 2 KB's worth of data in a keychain, transferred into a AMAS unit, then granted a new body altogether in Decagrammaton 's climax.
Kei.intro: Kei has a new body. She doesn't realize it, but she is a little more excited than usual.
trivia: Aris (Battle) and Kei are the first obtainable units whose armors are Composite.

Her birthdate keeps track of Aris 's.
The name Kei is likely a tribute to the visual novel developer Key.
In Traditional Chinese, her name is literally “Kei,” despite Simplified Chinese 凯伊.

weapon.name: Luminous・Nova
weapon.desc: A railgun exclusively for Kei. It's a perfect item for her as she takes a new step forward.

Mika.intro: Student of Trinity Integrated Academy and the former leader of "Pater", one of the student unions that make up Trinity. Mika always presents a happy smile and innocent appearance, but she seems to be troubled by something she's unable to confide in others.
relationships: Nagisa. Both are members of the Tea Party. Though they are childhood friends, they have disagreeing political views on Gehenna.

Seia. Seia thinks Mika is self-centered, impulsive, and self-destructive, and says she never cared for her. Still, she forgives Mika after the coup and later helps rescue her in turn. In response, Mika admits she likes Seia a lot despite the friction between them.

Koharu. A Make-Up Work Club member Mika admits to having bullied; Koharu still defends her against the mobs when her scheme fails and quietly saves Mika's belongings so that they can be returned to her later.

Sensei. Sensei refuses to give up on Mika even after her crimes are exposed, going back alone into the Arius district to save her. Mika, for her part, once tricks Sensei into staying in her dorm room until morning so that they can spend one more moment together.

She first appears in the main story's first volume, where she helps Abydos High School at Hifumi 's request, and is fully introduced in the main story's third volume alongside fellow Tea Party member Mika, asking Sensei to run the Make-Up Work Club.
Nagisa.intro: Affiliated with Trinity General Academy, she is the leader of "Filius", one of the student union bodies that make up Trinity, and the host of the "Tea Party" student council. Nagisa is refined and soft-spoken, but rarely reveals her true feelings, making her a complicated and mysterious character. Her hobby is preparing tea leaves and sweets for tea parties. She dreams of a day when many Trinity students would be invited to a tea party of hers.
relationships: Mika. Fellow Tea Party member and childhood friend of over ten years.
Seia. Fellow Tea Party member, and the one originally meant to hold Nagisa's position; Seia says the two of them are not very close.

Hifumi. A friend, and one Nagisa says she has always been fond of. At Hifumi's request she lends Trinity's artillery to Abydos, on the understanding that Hifumi will pay her back for it. She calls in the debt by making Hifumi president of the Make-Up Work Club and privately ordering her to find the traitor among her own clubmates. She is meanwhile counting Hifumi among the students to be expelled, on intelligence naming her the leader of a masked criminal organization, the Masked Swimsuit Gang. Afterwards she apologizes for doubting her and Hifumi forgives her, though Nagisa is left rattled by a parting message Hanako delivered earlier, which she took to be from Hifumi: "It was a funny fantasy, thinking we were ever really friends."

Arius Squad. The squad launched the missile on the Eden Treaty signing ceremony Nagisa was attending. She later meets the four of them privately and apologizes on Trinity's behalf, arguing that Trinity's excommunication of Arius was the original wrong.

weapon.name: Whip of Love
weapon.desc: Shun's sniper rifle. No matter how naughty a child may be, they will immediately start behaving once Shun takes out this gun. Of course, she never actually points the gun at the children.

weapon.name: Millennium-made Dumbbell (latest model)

Although she is not very familiar with the ways of ninja yet, she seems to be enjoying her time in the Ninjutsu Research Club with her senior Michiru, and Izuna.

Yukari.background: A first-year member of the Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy and the Hyakkaryouran Dispute Mediation Committee. Yukari is the heiress of the venerable Kadenokouji family. However, rather than inheriting the family business, she decided to pursue her dream of joining Hyakkaryoran. She takes pride in being a member of Hyakkaryouran and has a lot of energy. Although she sometimes falters, she has the strength of character to recover quickly. She respects her seniors, and especially admires Nagusa among them.

Yuuka.name: Yuuka
Yuuka.lead: Hayase Yuuka is a student of Millennium Science School and Seminar 's treasurer. Notable across Millennium for her mathematical prowess as well keeping a eye on the school's budget, she is first introduced in the the main story's prologue and one of the four students the player obtains upon beginning the game.
Yuuka.intro: Enrolled in the Millennium Science School, Yuuka is the treasurer of the student council known as "Seminar". A prominent mathematical genius even amongst Millennium's STEM-rich student base, she supervises the management of the school's budget. Yuuka's specialty is the abacus, and she has a habit of counting on one in order to compose herself when faced with complex and troubling matters.

exSkill.name: Q.E.D
exSkill.desc: Generates a shield around Yuuka with HP equal to 190~248% of her Healing. (Duration: 15~25 seconds )

weapon.name: Logic & Reason
weapon.desc: A pair of submachine guns used by Yuuka. They help Yuuka make rational and intelligent decisions even under pressure.

Yuzu.intro: Yuzu is the club president of the Game Development Club of Millennium Science School. She is very bad at speaking to people, and for that reason she almost never goes outside, instead spending the majority of her time inside a locker in the Game Development Club's club room. A lover of both playing and making games, her passion for them is no ordinary thing.
trivia: The name Yuzu is likely a tribute to the visual novel developer Yuzusoft.
